title: Quantifying Women's Marginalisation in Ibero-American Film Culture During the First Half of the Twentieth Century: A Network-Science Proposal*
reasoning: The paper focuses on quantifying the historical marginalisation of women in Ibero-American film culture using network science and a gender perspective. While it addresses issues of social inequality and data biases, it does not evaluate or benchmark specific religious, moral, or ethical frameworks as its primary subject matter. It aims to empirically study a socio-cultural phenomenon rather than assess normative systems of faith or ethics.
